_about: What you sell. One entry per offer; the key (e.g. main-offer) is how pages and campaigns refer to it. Every page sells one offer, in your words. page: standard for most offers; sprint only for a fixed discovery offer whose deliverable is a report (the report-book layout). Leave out prices and set price_text when you price on a call.

main-offer.label: [[Offer name, e.g. Website rebuild]]
main-offer.kind: [[What form it takes, e.g. a project, retainer, product, service, workshop, audit, or your own word]]
main-offer.for: [[Who it is for, e.g. owner-led trades businesses]]
main-offer.outcome: [[The result the buyer gets, in their words, e.g. More enquiries from your website]]
main-offer.hero_line: [[One line on what the offer is, e.g. A new website that brings in work, built in six weeks]]
main-offer.deliverable: [[What they receive, e.g. A new website, live on your domain]]
main-offer.price_note: [[A line under the price, e.g. Fixed fee, agreed before we start]]
